subject: Blake sinkhole
topic: NOAA found a giant sinkhole on the seafloor off the southeastern US.
script:
NOAA found a giant sinkhole on the seafloor off the southeastern US.
While mapping a huge area called the Blake Plateau, the team spotted a strange hole.
It's the only sinkhole of its kind they've found in the region.
So they sent their robot down to the very bottom.
Then it climbed back up along the sinkhole's walls.
Along the way, they saw strange rock formations and plenty of marine life.
And at the bottom of the sea, they found a soccer ball.
No one knows how this sinkhole formed. The team collected rock samples to help solve the mystery.
How do you think the ball got there?
pkg_title: NOAA Found a SINKHOLE at the Bottom of the Sea 🕳️ #Shorts
